## History

Hammond operated a small sawmill located in a clearing up the river. He lived there with his wife, Mrs. Hammond, and their eight children.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)_
